items.source: Return the current number of active connections that have been allocated from the data source or null if that information is not available.
items.translation: 返回已从数据源分配的活动连接数，如果该信息不可用则返回`null`。

items.source: Return the minimum number of idle connections in the pool or null if that information is not available.
items.translation: 返回池中空闲连接的最小数量，如果该信息不可用则返回 `null`。

items.source: Return the query to use to validate that a connection is valid or null if that information is not available.
items.translation: 返回用于验证连接是否有效的查询，或者如果该信息不可用则返回 `null`。

items.source: Return the maximum number of active connections that can be allocated at the same time or -1 if there is no limit. Can also return null if that information is not available.
items.translation: 返回可以同时分配的最大活动连接数，如果没有限制则返回 -1。如果该信息不可用，也可以返回 null。

items.source: Return the maximum number of active connections that can be allocated at the same time or -1 if there is no limit.
items.translation: 返回可同时分配的最大活动连接数，或者如果没有限制则返回 -1。

items.source: Return the number of established but idle connections. Can also return null if that information is not available.
items.translation: 返回已建立但空闲的连接数。如果该信息不可用，也可以返回 null。

items.source: The default auto-commit state of connections created by this pool. If not set (null), default is JDBC driver default (If set to null then the java.sql.Connection.setAutoCommit(boolean) method will not be called.)
items.translation: 此连接池创建的连接的默认自动提交状态。如果未设置（null），则默认为 JDBC 驱动程序的默认值（如果设置为 null，则不会调用 java.sql.Connection.setAutoCommit(boolean) 方法。）

items.source: The default auto-commit state of connections created by this pool.
items.translation: 此池创建的连接的默认自动提交状态。

items.source: Return the number of established but idle connections.
items.translation: 返回已建立但空闲的连接数。
